verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing documents usage metering through the Billing Meters API and meter events, and its webhooks push events in real time. These are building blocks a team could use to track usage and roll its own alerts. Nothing in the evidence shows a built-in view of current-cycle usage or accrued cost, for either customers (in the portal) or the team, and no usage thresholds or alerts are documented. Missing for 10: real-time accrued-cost visibility in the Dashboard or customer portal, configurable usage thresholds, pre-invoice alerts or notifications, independent corroboration.
